name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
summary:
Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

In this monster-raising RPG, control Yomi as she does everything in her power to help manage the monsters of the underworld. Gather monster parts and experience to get stronger! Farm them and release the monsters back into the caverns to gain even further stats. Delve deeper and deeper, discovering all the secrets... and maybe even make a few friends along the way! Being a sacrifice isn't all bad, right?
